title: 第五章：借雨十年
content_zh:
许还山把主债线扯断时，雨神庙上空炸开一声惊雷。

    不是天雷。

    是账雷。

    债契被强行拆穿时，天地之间自然生出的反噬。

    井底老人周问礼喷出一口黑血，胸口那尊金身裂开一道细缝。

    雨神债壳则像被掏空了半边身子，庞大的血肉不断塌陷，又不断被黑水撑起。

    它盯着许还山，声音阴毒：

    “你以为看见真账，就能赢？”

    许还山从井底爬上来，浑身湿透，脸色白得像纸。

    “我一般不觉得自己能赢。”

    他把周问礼从井底拖出。

    “我只觉得你们账做得太烂。”

    姜照雪撑伞站起，伤得不轻，却仍旧站到许还山身侧。

    “主债线已经现形，只要找到灵河阿青，证明神应来自灵河，雨神债就不成立。”

    许还山问：“阿青在哪？”

    周问礼趴在地上，声音微弱。

    “井下还有一层。”

    许还山一怔。

    周问礼指向井底。

    “当年青伞人封的不是井，是河眼。阿青被压在河眼下面十年。”

    雨神债壳忽然笑了。

    “你们见不到它了。”

    许还山眯眼。

    雨神张开嘴，吐出一枚青黑色珠子。

    珠子里有水声，有哭声，还有一条细小的青色影子在挣扎。

    周问礼脸色剧变。

    “河眼珠！”

    雨神冷声道：“灵河早被本君炼成河眼珠。没有它，南荒七村早已干死。本君吃他们寿数，又有何错？”

    许还山盯着那枚珠子。

    “终于承认十年前的雨不是你下的了？”

    雨神脸色一僵。

    姜照雪立刻道：“许还山，记账。”

    许还山抬起算盘。

    七十二枚算盘珠只剩四十九枚还能亮起，其余已经裂开。

    他拨动一珠。

    “灵雨神君亲口认账。”

    算盘珠一震。

    半空中浮出一行字：

    十年前灵雨，源自井底灵河。

    雨神怒吼：“你诈我！”

    许还山认真点头。

    “是啊。”

    他顿了顿，又道：“不过你也不算太亏，至少死得明白。”

    雨神彻底发狂。

    它不再维持神明威仪，庞大的债壳猛然炸开，无数黑水化作利箭，射向庙内所有活人。

    里正、文吏、小吏、周问礼。

    它要把所有证人都杀光。

    姜照雪伞光横扫，挡住大半黑水。

    许还山扑向周问礼，替老人挡下一道水箭，肩头瞬间被洞穿。

    他疼得眼前发黑，仍死死盯着雨神口中的河眼珠。

    “姜照雪，打不打得过？”

    姜照雪面无表情。

    “正面打不过。”

    “那偷呢？”

    “可以试。”

    许还山笑了。

    “我喜欢你们前天债院的人，实诚。”

    姜照雪瞥他一眼。

    “我负责拖住它，你取珠。”

    “我？”

    “它现在最怕你。”

    许还山叹气：“这话听起来不像夸我。”

    雨神再次扑来。

    姜照雪一步踏出，青白伞旋转如月，挡住雨神正面。伞骨上的裂纹越来越多，但她一步不退。

    许还山则钻进雨神身下的黑水里。

    他身上有三百七十二张命债，雨神不敢立刻吞他，因为一旦吞掉许还山，就等于吞掉所有证据，也等于把假账彻底纳入自身神格。

    可它也不能放他靠近河眼珠。

    于是满地黑水化作手掌，疯狂撕扯许还山。

    许还山身上的衣袍被撕开，皮肉被扯出一道道血痕。
content_en:
When Xu Huanshan cut off the main debt line, a thunder exploded over the Rain Temple.

    Not thunder.

    It's an account thunder.

    When the debt contract is forcibly broken, a natural backlash occurs between heaven and earth.

    Zhou Wenli, the old man at the bottom of the well, spat out a mouthful of black blood, and a thin crack opened in the golden body on his chest.

    The Rain God's Debt Shell seemed to have had half of its body hollowed out, with its huge flesh and blood constantly collapsing and being held up by the black water.

    It stared at Xu Huanshan and said in a sinister voice:

    "Do you think you can win if you see the real account?"

    Xu Huanshan climbed up from the bottom of the well, soaked to the skin and his face as white as paper.

    "I generally don't think I can win."

    He dragged Zhou Wenli out from the bottom of the well.

    "I just think your accounting is too bad."

    Jiang Zhaoxue stood up with an umbrella. He was seriously injured, but he still stood beside Xu Huanshan.

    "The main debt line has been revealed. As long as we find Linghe Aqing and prove that the god should come from Linghe, the Rain God debt will not be established."

    Xu Huanshan asked: "Where is Ah Qing?"

    Zhou Wenli lay on the ground, his voice weak.

    "There is another layer below the well."

    Xu Huanshan was startled.

    Zhou Wenli pointed to the bottom of the well.

    "Back then, the Qing Umbrella people sealed not the well, but the eye of the river. Ah Qing was trapped under the eye of the river for ten years."

    Rain God Debt Shell suddenly smiled.

    "You can't see it anymore."

    Xu Huanshan narrowed his eyes.

    The Rain God opened his mouth and spit out a blue-black bead.

    There was the sound of water, crying, and a small blue shadow struggling in the beads.

    Zhou Wenli's expression changed drastically.

    "River eyes!"

    The Rain God said coldly: "Linghe has been turned into a river eye by me. Without it, the seven villages in the Southern Wilderness would have been killed long ago. What's wrong with me taking their lifespan?"

    Xu Huanshan stared at the bead.

    "Finally admit that the rain ten years ago was not caused by you?"

    The Rain God's face froze.

    Jiang Zhaoxue immediately said: "Xu Huanshan, keep accounts."

    Xu Huanshan raised his abacus.

    Only forty-nine of the seventy-two abacus beads can still light up, and the rest have cracked.

    He moved a bead.

    "Lord Lingyu personally admitted the blame."

    The abacus was shaken.

    A line of words appeared in mid-air:

    Ten years ago, the spiritual rain originated from the spiritual river at the bottom of the well.

    The Rain God roared: "You deceived me!"

    Xu Huanshan nodded seriously.

    "Yeah."

    He paused and then said: "But it's not too bad for you. At least you will die knowingly."

    The rain god went completely crazy.

    It no longer maintained the majesty of the gods, the huge debt shell suddenly exploded, and countless black water turned into sharp arrows, shooting at all the living people in the temple.

    Li Zheng, Wen Li, Xiao Li, Zhou Wenli.

    It wants to kill all the witnesses.

    Jiang Zhaoxue's umbrella swept across the sky, blocking most of the black water.

    Xu Huanshan rushed towards Zhou Wenli and blocked a water arrow for the old man, and his shoulder was instantly pierced.

    His eyes were so painful that his eyes were black, and he was still staring at the river eyes in the Rain God's mouth.

    "Jiang Zhaoxue, can you beat me?"

    Jiang Zhaoxue's face was expressionless.

    "You can't beat him head-on."

    "What about stealing?"

    "You can try."

    Xu Huanshan smiled.

    "I like you guys from the Debt Court the day before yesterday, you are sincere."

    Jiang Zhaoxue glanced at him.

    "I'll hold it while you get the beads."

    "Me?"

    "It's most afraid of you now."

    Xu Huanshan sighed: "That doesn't sound like a compliment to me."

    The rain god strikes again.

    Jiang Zhaoxue took a step forward, the green and white umbrella spinning like the moon, blocking the front of the Rain God. There were more and more cracks on the umbrella ribs, but she didn't take a step back.

    Xu Huanshan got into the black water under the Rain God.

    He had three hundred and seventy-two life debts on his body, and the Rain God did not dare to swallow him immediately, because once he swallowed Xu Huanshan, it would be equivalent to swallowing all the evidence, and it would also be equivalent to completely incorporating the false accounts into his own godhead.

    But it couldn't let him get close to the river eye.

    Then the black water all over the ground turned into palms, tearing Xu Huanshan wildly.

    Xu Huanshan's robe was torn open, and his skin and flesh were torn out with bloody traces.
title_en: Chapter 5: Ten years of borrowing rain
